Colleagues can see Mobile Banking Access as checked, Last Login Channel as Mobile and Last Mobile Access Date Time as current date and time. ","1. Colleagues should be able to see see Mobile Banking Access as checked, Last Login Channel as Mobile and Last Mobile Access Date Time as current date and time in SF party level other details tab. ","","" SITUAT-CTB-018_AOS_01,Easy Access non-ISA accountBelow minimum balanceFunding period + grace period expiredAccount automatically closed,Medium,Active,51744643,SITUAT/Milestone-2/HR-CTB-018 - Auto close Underfunded Accounts(below minimum balance)/AOS,Other,Not Automated,"Verify an Active Easy Access non-ISA account is automatically closed when the balance remains below the minimum required balance after the funding period and grace period. ",Test Case Steps,2026-07-10T10:09:19.000Z,Akshay Save,2026-07-30T06:43:46.000Z,Akshay Save,"","1. Onboard a new customer, log in to the CTB Mobile Banking application, and verify successful customer access. 2. Open a new Easy Access non-ISA account for the customer and fund it with an amount below the product’s configured minimum balance requirement. 3. Leave the account underfunded without any additional deposits until the funding period and associated grace period have fully expired. 4. After the overnight batch job execution, verify from the Mobile Banking application that the account has been automatically closed. 5. Verify remaining balance of a closed Easy Access non-ISA account is successfully transferred to the linked account upon automatic account closure. 6. Verify in Clearbank that the balance transfer is completed successfully to the customer’s linked account. 7. NS123 notification is generated successfully to the customer via Email and Letter. 8. Log in to Salesforce, search for the party and navigate to the financial accounts details. 9. Verify that the account status is displayed as Closed in Salesforce. 10. Log in to Mambu, search for the financial accounts details of the same party. 11. Verify that the account status is displayed as Closed in Mambu. 12. Verify closing account statement is generated for the closed account and the same is available in statements section for customer download. ","1. The customer is successfully onboarded and can log in to the CTB Mobile Banking application with valid credentials. 2. A new Easy Access non-ISA account is successfully opened, and the account balance reflects an amount below the configured minimum balance requirement. 3. The account remains underfunded throughout the funding period and grace period, with no additional funding activity recorded. 4. Following the overnight batch job execution, the Easy Access non-ISA account is automatically closed in accordance with the configured business rules. 5. The remaining available balance in the closed Easy Access non-ISA account is automatically transferred to the customer’s linked account without any loss of funds. 6. ClearBank reflects a successful transfer transaction, and the linked account balance is credited with the transferred amount from the closed account. 7. An NS123 notification is successfully generated and issued to the customer through both Email and Letter channels, containing the account closure details. 8. The user can successfully log in to Salesforce, locate the party record, and navigate to the associated financial account details. 9. The financial account status in Salesforce is displayed as Closed, accurately reflecting the account closure performed by the overnight batch process. 10. The user can successfully log in to Mambu, locate the same financial account, and access the account details. 11. The financial account status in Mambu is displayed as Closed, confirming successful synchronization of the account closure across Mobile Banking, Salesforce, and Mambu. 12. Closing account statement should get generated for the closed account and the same is available in statements section for customer download. ",Untested,Castle Trust Bank,HR-CTB-018 | SITUAT - Auto close Underfunded Accounts(below minimum balance),TR-310,2026-07-21T11:11:00.000Z,Mbhatnadh,New,Manual,2026-07-23T17:40:45.000Z,Mbhatnadh,"","","",Akshay Save,"","1. Customer account is in Active. 2. Funding period and grace period are configured. 3. Account balance is below the minimum required balance. 4. Allow the FTD account to reach maturity without the customer selecting or submitting any maturity instructions. 4. Upon maturity, the system automatically identifies the product configured in the FTD\'s DefaultMaturityProduct field in Mambu and check if customer already has one maturity account is already created then that is being used. 5. The accrued interest earned on the matured FTD is transferred to the customer\'s preferred transaction account. 6. The system transfers the entire principal balance from the matured FTD account to the existing Maturity holding account. 7. After successful fund transfers, the original FTD account is automatically closed with a zero remaining balance. 8. The FTD reaches its maturity date. No maturity instruction is found for the account. 4. The system successfully retrieves the DefaultMaturityProduct configuration from Mambu and usedexisting maturity holding account. This account should also exist in Clearbank. 5. The accrued interest amount is successfully credited to the customer\'s preferred transaction account. The transaction is recorded with the correct amount and description in Clearbank. 6. The full principal balance is successfully transferred from the matured FTD account to the existing Maturity Holding account. 7. The original FTD account status is updated to Closed, and its balance becomes zero. No further transactions are permitted on the closed account. 8. ",Test Case Steps,2026-07-14T06:00:05.000Z,Akshay Save,2026-07-14T06:00:05.000Z,Akshay Save,"","1. Onboard a new customer, log in to the CTB Mobile Banking application, and verify successful customer access. 2. Open a new Easy Access non-ISA account for the customer and fund it. 3. Navigate to Statements section and verify Genrate statement option is displayed 4. Verify that the Mobile App retrieves SV-AdHocStatementTimePeriod from the backend Config Service API when opening statement options. 5. Verify that selecting Generate Statement displays From Date and To Date fields. 6. Verify that the user can enter valid values in the From Date and To Date fields. 7. User hits the submit button and success message is displayed “Statement will be available in document section within specified timeframe”. 8. Verify Customer is able to view the transaction statement. 9. Try to generate one more statement before the first request is completed. ","1. Customer onboarding is completed successfully and the customer can log in to the CTB Mobile Banking application without errors. 2. An Easy Access non-ISA account is successfully opened and funded. 3. The Generate Statement option is displayed within the Statements section. 4. The Mobile App successfully retrieves the SV-AdHocStatementTimePeriod configuration value from the backend Config Service API when statement options are accessed. 5. Selecting Generate Statement displays both From Date and To Date fields. 6. The user is able to enter valid dates within the permitted date range. 7. Upon clicking Submit, the confirmation message “Statement will be available in document section within specified timeframe” is displayed. 8. The customer can open and view the transaction statement successfully, and the statement reflects the correct account transactions for the selected date range. 9. The user should not be able to submit a second statement request while a previously submitted request is still being processed. The statement generation functionality should remain disabled until the first request is completed. ",Test Case Steps,2026-07-14T06:03:06.000Z,Akshay Save,2026-07-14T06:03:07.000Z,Akshay Save,"","1. Onboard a new customer, log in to the CTB Mobile Banking application, and verify successful customer access. 2. Open a new Easy Access non-ISA account for the customer and fund it. 3. Navigate to Statements section and verify Genrate statement option is displayed 4. Verify that the Mobile App retrieves SV-AdHocStatementTimePeriod from the backend Config Service API when opening statement options. 5. Verify that selecting Generate Statement displays From Date and To Date fields. 6. Verify that the user can enter valid values in the From Date and To Date fields. 7. User hits the submit button and success message is displayed “Statement will be available in document section within specified timeframe”. 8. Verify Customer is able to view the transaction statement. 9. Verify NS113 is sent to the customer when statement is successfully generated. 10. Verify the generated statement has date and time displayed in it. ","1. Customer onboarding is completed successfully and the customer can log in to the CTB Mobile Banking application without errors. 2. An Easy Access non-ISA account is successfully opened and funded. 3. The Generate Statement option is displayed within the Statements section. 4. The Mobile App successfully retrieves the SV-AdHocStatementTimePeriod configuration value from the backend Config Service API when statement options are accessed. 5. Selecting Generate Statement displays both From Date and To Date fields. 6. The user is able to enter valid dates within the permitted date range. 7. Upon clicking Submit, the confirmation message “Statement will be available in document section within specified timeframe” is displayed. 8. The customer can open and view the transaction statement successfully, and the statement reflects the correct account transactions for the selected date range. 9. Customer should receive NS113 when statement is successfully generated. 10. The generated statement should have date and time displayed in it. ","" HR-CTB-028_AOS_01,Verify when an FTD account reaches maturity and the customer has not selected a maturity option. CTB-1 day Fixed Rate E-Saver,Medium,Active,52402997,SITUAT/Milestone-2/HR-CTB-028 - Where a customer has not specified a Maturity option for a Fixed Term Deposit the account should automatically mature into a Holding Account/AOS,Other,Not Automated,"Verify when an FTD account reaches maturity and the customer has not selected a maturity option ",Test Case Steps,2026-07-17T09:46:22.000Z,Akshay Save,2026-07-27T10:16:42.000Z,Akshay Save,"","1. Onboard a new customer, enable CTB Mobile Banking access, and verify successful login and account accessibility. 2. Open and fund a new CTB-1 day Fixed Rate E-Saver account, ensuring the account is active and reflects the deposited balance. 3. Before the account reaches maturity, the customer receives the following two notifications: Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder One (NS115) and Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder Two (NS114) 4. Allow the FTD account to reach maturity without the customer selecting or submitting any maturity instructions. 5. Upon maturity, the system automatically identifies the product configured in the FTD’s DefaultMaturityProduct field in Mambu creates a new account. New account also exists in Clearbank. 6. The accrued interest earned on the matured FTD is transferred to the customer’s preferred transaction account. 7. The system transfers the entire principal balance from the matured FTD account to the newly created Maturity holding account. 8. After successful fund transfers, the original FTD account is automatically closed with a zero remaining balance. 9. The system sends notification NS116 to inform the customer that the FTD has matured, the funds have been automatically transferred to the new account. 10. Verify that the new account is active and the balances are transferred. ","1. Customer is successfully onboarded. Mobile Banking access is enabled. Customer can log in successfully and view the transaction account without any errors. 2. A new CTB-1 day Fixed Rate E-Saver account is created successfully with Active status. The funded amount is correctly credited, and the account balance matches the deposited amount. 3. Before the account reaches its maturity date, the customer should receive the following two notifications: Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder One (NS115) and Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder Two (NS114). 4. The FTD reaches its maturity date. No maturity instruction is found for the account. 5. The system successfully retrieves the DefaultMaturityProduct configuration from Mambu and automatically creates a new maturity holding account using the configured product. This account should also exist in Clearbank. 6. The accrued interest amount is successfully credited to the customer’s preferred transaction account. The transaction is recorded with the correct amount and description in Clearbank.6.The full principal balance is successfully transferred from the matured FTD account to the newly created Maturity Holding account. 7. The original FTD account status is updated to Closed, and its balance becomes zero. No further transactions are permitted on the closed account. 8. Notification NS116 is successfully generated and sent to the customer. 9. The newly created Maturity Holding account is in Active status. The principal balance is available in the new account. ",In Progress,Castle Trust Bank,HR-CTB-028 | SITUAT - Where a customer has not specified a Maturity option for a Fixed Term Deposit the account should automatically mature into a Holding Account,TR-313,2026-07-21T11:14:17.000Z,Mbhatnadh,New,Manual,2026-07-23T17:42:14.000Z,Mbhatnadh,"",2026-07-29T15:52:46.000Z,Akshay Save,Akshay Save,"","Configuration of DefaultMaturityProduct field on FTD product definitions in Mambuovernight FTD Maturity job runs "," ","" HR-CTB-028_AOS_06,Verify when an FTD account reaches maturity and the customer has not selected a maturity option. Allow the FTD account to reach maturity without the customer selecting or submitting any maturity instructions. 4. Upon maturity, the system automatically identifies the product configured in the FTD\'s DefaultMaturityProduct field in Mambu creates a new account. New account also exists in Clearbank. 5. The accrued interest earned on the matured FTD is transferred to the customer\'s preferred transaction account is unsuccessful then NS906 Exception - Maturity Interest Payment Failure is sent to the customer. 6. The system fails to transfers the entire principal balance from the matured FTD account to the newly created Maturity holding account. System sends NS905 notification Exception - Maturity Interest Payment Failure to the customer. 7. After unsuccessful fund transfers, the original FTD account is not closed and remains active. 8. The system does not send notification NS116. ","1. Customer is successfully onboarded. Mobile Banking access is enabled. Customer can log in successfully and view the transaction account without any errors. 2. A new CTB-2 Weeks Fixed Rate Saver account is created successfully with Active status. The funded amount is correctly credited, and the account balance matches the deposited amount. 3. The FTD reaches its maturity date. No maturity instruction is found for the account. 4. The system successfully retrieves the DefaultMaturityProduct configuration from Mambu and automatically creates a new maturity holding account using the configured product. This account should also exist in Clearbank. 5. The accrued interest amount is not successfully credited to the customer\'s preferred transaction account and customer should receive NS906 notification. 6. System should move the funds to the suspense account, send NS905 notification to the customer and creates a payment failure case in Salesforce. 7. The original FTD account status remains active. 8. Notification NS116 not sent to the customer, PAYMENTS\_FAILED\_AB notification should be sent. Onboard a new customer, enable CTB Mobile Banking access, and verify successful login and account accessibility. 2. Open and fund a new CTB-2 Weeks Fixed Rate Saver account, ensuring the account is active and reflects the deposited balance. 3. Before the account reaches maturity, the customer receives the following two notifications: Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder One (NS115) and Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder Two (NS114) 4. Allow the FTD account to reach maturity without the customer selecting or submitting any maturity instructions. 5. Upon maturity, the system automatically identifies the product configured in the FTD’s DefaultMaturityProduct field in Mambu creates a new account. New account also exists in Clearbank. 6. The accrued interest earned on the matured FTD is transferred to the customer’s preferred transaction account. 7. The system transfers the entire principal balance from the matured FTD account to the newly created Maturity holding account. 8. After successful fund transfers, the original FTD account is automatically closed with a zero remaining balance. 9. The system sends notification NS116 to inform the customer that the FTD has matured, the funds have been automatically transferred to the new account. 10. Verify that the new account is active and the balances are transferred. ","1. Customer is successfully onboarded. Mobile Banking access is enabled. Customer can log in successfully and view the transaction account without any errors. 2. A new CTB-2 Weeks Fixed Rate Saver account is created successfully with Active status. The funded amount is correctly credited, and the account balance matches the deposited amount. 3. Before the account reaches maturity, the customer receives the following two notifications: Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder One (NS115) and Fixed Term Deposit Maturity Reminder Two (NS114) 4. The FTD reaches its maturity date. No maturity instruction is found for the account. 5. The system successfully retrieves the DefaultMaturityProduct configuration from Mambu and automatically creates a new maturity holding account using the configured product. This account should also exist in Clearbank. 6. The accrued interest amount is successfully credited to the customer’s preferred transaction account. The transaction is recorded with the correct amount and description in Clearbank.6.The full principal balance is successfully transferred from the matured FTD account to the newly created Maturity Holding account. 7. The original FTD account status is updated to Closed, and its balance becomes zero. No further transactions are permitted on the closed account. 8. Notification NS116 is successfully generated and sent to the customer. 9. The newly created Maturity Holding account is in Active status. The principal balance is available in the new account.
